profile.name: Piyush Sonawane
profile.headline: I build software that works.
profile.subheadline: Full-stack systems. AI-enabled applications. APIs. Cloud infrastructure. Developer tooling.
profile.bio: Final year Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering student with Software Development Engineer internship experience and hands-on full-stack development across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, testing, debugging, deployment, and DevOps. Experienced with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, SQL, Docker, Git, Supabase, and cloud technologies. Strong in end-to-end application development, authentication, REST APIs, database integration, testing, CI/CD, troubleshooting, and software delivery.

projects.title: KH147-TechOrbit (Chord)
projects.tagline: Collaborative AI Disaster Response & Crisis Telemetry Platform
projects.summary: A collaborative human-AI crisis response platform engineered to coordinate multi-agency relief teams, emergency dispatch requests, automated situation synthesis, and geospatial crisis mapping during regional disasters.
projects.architecture: Incident Feed & Geolocation → Edge Stream Processing → AI Priority Classifier → Multi-Agency Dispatch Dashboard
highlights: Constructed a high-concurrency disaster coordination platform linking local relief volunteers and centralized emergency squads.
Engineered real-time interactive coordinate tracking with Leaflet and open tile routing.
Integrated AI decision pipelines to classify urgent medical triage vs. supplies dispatch requests with zero latency bottleneck.
Deployed with sub-100ms cold starts on Vercel Edge infrastructure.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Architected as a local-resilient web client that operates smoothly over low-bandwidth cellular links encountered in disaster zones.
projects.challenges: Handling erratic GPS pings from field units. Implemented spatial deduplication and client-side dead reckoning.
projects.lessonsLearned: Mission-critical applications require instant visual clarity, unambiguous action buttons, and zero extraneous dependencies.

projects.title: OneOps
projects.tagline: AI Incident Commander for Distributed Infrastructure & Edge Devices
projects.summary: An automated incident response commander that monitors real hardware device telemetry, inspects repository codebases, synthesizes root-cause diagnoses, and generates sandboxed remediation pull requests.
projects.architecture: Device Telemetry Ingest → Diagnostic Rule Synthesizer → GitHub Tree Inspection → Docker Patch Sandbox → Automated Verification Run
highlights: Ingested hardware sensor metrics, crash dumps, and daemon logs from live Linux edge devices.
Automated deep code inspection against corresponding GitHub repositories using commit trees and blame history.
Synthesized reproducible fix patches and validated them within ephemeral Docker test containers.
Maintained an operational incident memory database to prevent recurring architectural regressions.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Enforced strict read-only execution modes and explicit user verification before dispatching write actions to production source trees.
projects.challenges: Rate limiting on GitHub API during rapid repository tree scans. Implemented client-side caching with ETag validation and exponential backoff.
projects.lessonsLearned: Reliable developer tooling prioritizes reproducibility, explicit git logs, and defensive fail-closed architecture over magical automation.

projects.title: OneMeal
projects.summary: A full-stack React and TypeScript platform connecting food donors, NGOs, and community receivers through donation workflows, automated Gemini AI food freshness inspection, and geolocation routing.
projects.architecture: React Client → Firebase Auth Session → Firestore Real-time Stream → Gemini Vision Inspection API → Leaflet Map Routing
highlights: Implemented secure multi-tier authentication for donors, relief organizations, and volunteer drivers.
Integrated Gemini Vision API for automatic classification and freshness validation of food photographs before dispatch.
Engineered live donation tracking and pickup radius discovery using Leaflet and OpenStreetMap.
Integrated multi-lingual translation streams for diverse community volunteer access.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Chose Firestore for optimistic updates and native offline persistence. Selected Gemini Vision API to prevent subjective donor claims and streamline food quality grading prior to volunteer physical arrival.
projects.challenges: Handling intermittent mobile connectivity during field delivery drop-offs. Solved using client-side caching, local coordinate queuing, and idempotent background sync.
projects.lessonsLearned: Designed robust error boundaries around third-party image inference APIs and avoided blocking submission UX while vision analysis completes.

projects.title: OneTravel
projects.tagline: Multi-Stop Geographic Itinerary & Path Optimization Platform
projects.summary: A high-performance travel planning engine with multi-stop geographic path calculation, live weather forecasting feeds, and budgetary constraints tailored for multi-city transit.
projects.architecture: User Route Parameters → Leaflet Geocoding → Spatial Path Optimization → OpenWeather Ingestion → Interactive Schedule Matrix
highlights: Designed deterministic route scheduling factoring in real-world transit time and weather conditions.
Integrated OpenWeather API to provide proactive inclement weather advisories along transit corridors.
Implemented offline itinerary caching via IndexedDB for travelers with limited network access.
Engineered responsive touch-optimized waypoint reordering with drag-and-drop mechanics.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Decoupled route computation from DOM rendering to maintain consistent 60 FPS interaction while manipulating complex geographic polylines.
projects.challenges: Polyline rendering bottlenecks on mobile viewports. Addressed by downsampling coordinate points with Douglas-Peucker simplification.
projects.lessonsLearned: Geographic interfaces benefit immensely from immediate visual feedback and clear milestone markers.

projects.title: AI Stroke Detection System
projects.tagline: Medical Imaging & Automated Diagnostic Slice Visualizer
projects.summary: An end-to-end medical imaging platform for authenticated CT scan uploads, automated stroke subtype classification (ischemic vs. hemorrhagic), lesion mask generation, and interactive clinical slice visualization.
projects.architecture: React Dashboard → Express API Gateway (JWT) → Multer Stream Buffer → Containerized Python/TensorFlow Engine → Lesion Mask & Heatmap Output → MongoDB Audit Log
highlights: Architected an authenticated clinical dashboard for hospital radiology technicians and on-call neurologists.
Built resilient chunked streaming for high-resolution medical CT scan image sets.
Orchestrated a decoupled Python inference microservice executing TensorFlow convolution models for lesion segmentation.
Engineered an interactive web-based slice visualizer with dynamic opacity controls for predicted lesion masks.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Separated the Node.js API gateway from the heavy Python inference runtime via Docker to prevent CPU-intensive CV computations from degrading HTTP gateway throughput.
projects.challenges: Synchronous model inference initially caused gateway timeouts on multi-slice scans. Restructured the bridge into an asynchronous job queue with event status polling.
projects.lessonsLearned: Medical software requires rigorous audit logs, reproducible preprocessing pipelines, and deterministic DICOM windowing thresholds.

projects.title: Robo App
projects.summary: A real-time telemetry visualization dashboard and communication controller for embedded robotics platforms, providing serial bus communication and low-latency motor control feedback.
projects.architecture: Serial Bus Stream → Web Serial Buffer → Binary Packet Demuxer → Canvas Gauge Visualizer → Low-latency Control Pipeline
highlights: Built direct browser-to-microcontroller serial communication using modern Web Serial API without proprietary drivers.
Engineered real-time 60 FPS canvas dial and trajectory indicators for motor speed and battery level.
Designed packet framing with CRC checksums ensuring zero corrupt instructions reaching hardware.
Implemented emergency kill-switch commands guaranteed to transmit with highest interrupt priority.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Utilized binary telemetry encoding over raw strings to reduce serial bus bandwidth utilization by 74%.
projects.challenges: Buffer overrun on high-baud-rate sensor bursts. Implemented a ring buffer in JavaScript to prevent dropped packets.
projects.lessonsLearned: Hardware engineering interfaces must fail safely and provide clear physical status indicators at all times.

projects.title: OneFlux
projects.tagline: Reactive State Management & Observable Event Bus
projects.summary: An ultra-lightweight reactive state management and event-driven store for modern web applications featuring zero external dependencies and sub-2KB bundle footprint.
projects.architecture: Action Dispatch → Immutable Reducer Stream → Subscriber Notifier Queue → Selective Component Re-render
highlights: Implemented zero-dependency micro-observable architecture with sub-2KB footprint.
Engineered time-travel debugging capabilities with serializable state diff snapshots.
Achieved 100% test coverage across complex asynchronous state transitions.
Published with complete TypeScript definitions and comprehensive integration guides.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Avoided Proxies in core loops to guarantee compatibility with constrained embedded browsers and legacy mobile engines.
projects.challenges: Preventing memory leaks from abandoned subscriptions. Implemented auto-cleanup symbol disposers.
projects.lessonsLearned: Clean API ergonomics and predictable behavior drive developer adoption far more than complex features.

projects.title: OneGaurd
projects.tagline: Zero-Trust Client-Side API Payload Sanitization Layer
projects.summary: A client-side security middleware and schema contract defense layer mitigating injection vulnerabilities, parameter tampering, and malformed network payloads before network dispatch.

dna.Threat Coverage: XSS, SQLi Pattern Heuristics, Schema Drift

projects.architecture: Outgoing HTTP Request → Schema Validation Gate → Payload Deep Sanitization → Cryptographic Checksum → Safe Network Transport
highlights: Built declarative schema validation protecting REST endpoints from client-side parameter pollution.
Engineered deep string sanitization stripping script tags, unicode exploits, and malformed JSON payloads.
Added zero-overhead development mode warning logs highlighting schema contract drift.
Integrated seamlessly with modern fetch and Axios network clients.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Designed with a fail-closed philosophy: any payload failing validation is rejected before initiating network traffic.
projects.challenges: Performance impact on deep nested JSON payloads. Solved with compiled fast-path validator functions.
projects.lessonsLearned: Defense-in-depth requires validation at both client boundaries and server controllers.

projects.title: Portfolio Core
projects.tagline: Editorial Engineering Portfolio & Production PWA System
projects.summary: The production-grade editorial portfolio web application featuring zero-dependency vanilla styling, responsive horizontal gliding showcase, offline Service Worker, and PWA capabilities.
projects.architecture: Static Minimal Asset Delivery → Service Worker Offline Cache → Dynamic Horizontal Reel Stream → Accessible Dialog Modals
highlights: Engineered 100% vanilla CSS design system honoring strict anti-vibe-coding constraints.
Constructed interactive horizontal project reel with continuous gliding, drag-to-scroll, and pause-on-hover.
Integrated Service Worker caching ensuring instant offline loading across all devices.
Implemented accessible keyboard navigation, command palette (⌘K), and responsive modals.
projects.engineeringDecisions: Chose Vanilla CSS and zero-dependency JS to eliminate framework bloat and guarantee sub-second initial load on any device.
projects.challenges: Balancing complex interactive animations with strict anti-vibe-coding editorial aesthetics. Solved with precise typographic hierarchy and subtle physics.
projects.lessonsLearned: High-craft editorial typography paired with native web standards produces timeless, blazing-fast web software.
